description: The projects of the EasyMesh labs, grouped by goal, and the commit each was last pinned at (./pin); the images the labs run that are built outside a lab VM, and the commit each was built from. ./sync clones the projects into this workspace.
end_goal: One EasyMesh system on wmediumd: native EasyMesh agents and existing OpenSync pods, through the EMOSA adapter, together.

goals.adapter: The OpenSync adapter: existing OpenSync pods in an EasyMesh system
goals.physical: EasyMesh on physical hardware: certified extenders and real clients, the protocol learned on the wire

projects.name: meta-cmf-bananapi-vcpe
projects.title: RDK EasyMesh
projects.about: RDK-B on Banana Pi images in containers: EasyMesh, virtual RF and medium (wmediumd), optimizer, interactive room

projects.name: prplmesh-lab
projects.title: prplMesh
projects.about: The same EasyMesh lab on native prplMesh

projects.name: easymesh-medium
projects.title: RF medium
projects.about: The RF medium every lab runs on: wmediumd and its patch series, the hwsim patches, the room configurator and its rooms, the medium's console; one of the labs' two core components, used by the RDK and prplMesh labs at a pinned commit

projects.name: easymesh-optimizer
projects.title: Optimizer
projects.about: The steering optimizer both virtual labs run and the room service that runs it live: one policy core with an adapter per controller stack (RDK through em_cli, prplMesh through NBAPI), its scenarios, configurations, tests and manuals; pinned by the RDK and prplMesh labs

projects.name: emosa-lab
projects.title: EMOSA
projects.about: The EasyMesh-to-OpenSync adapter: existing OpenSync pods as EasyMesh agents

projects.name: opensync-lab
projects.title: OpenSync
projects.about: A representative router (mv3) and OpenSync pods with virtual radios and clients

projects.name: easymesh-lab
projects.title: Protocol lab
projects.about: A from-scratch Python IEEE 1905.1/EasyMesh controller and teaching panel, driving certified extenders (TP-Link RE653BE) with real tri-band clients
